title: Fleet & Logistics Efficiency
description: Time-in-status is read from bronze iot.truck_position_events directly (not silver.truck_current_position, which only keeps latest state), mirroring fact_shipments' own precedent for lifecycle timestamps.

targets.rawSql: SELECT truck_status, count(*) FROM silver.truck_current_position GROUP BY truck_status

WITH events AS (SELECT truck_id, truck_status, event_at, LEAD(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY event_at) AS next_event_at FROM iot.truck_position_events WHERE event_at > now() - interval '24 hours') SELECT truck_status, sum(extract(epoch FROM (coalesce(next_event_at, now()) - event_at)))/3600.0 AS total_hours FROM events GROUP BY truck_status ORDER BY total_hours DESC

SELECT t.name, count(*) AS deliveries FROM gold.fact_shipments s JOIN gold.dim_truck t ON t.truck_key = s.truck_key AND t.dbt_valid_to IS NULL WHERE s.is_delivered AND s.delivery_time > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY deliveries DESC

panels.title: Avg orders aboard per active run

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(orders_aboard) FROM (SELECT tp.truck_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM silver.purchase_orders_current po WHERE po.truck_id = tp.truck_id AND po.status = 'in-transit') AS orders_aboard FROM silver.truck_current_position tp WHERE tp.truck_status != 'free') t
